title: Connector search-index boundary for unresolved continuity identifiers

observed: The GitHub repository metadata reports code search indexing as unavailable for MirrorCartographer/mirror-cartographer-ui.
Connector code search returned zero results for M-004 and for the combined M-004 M-005 M-006 query.
Commit search returned zero results for M-004, M-005, and M-006.
Branch search with an empty query returned no branch records and therefore did not establish exhaustive branch coverage.
inferred: Zero connector code-search results are not evidence that the identifiers do not exist because code search indexing is unavailable.

Zero commit-message search results only excludes matching commit-message text within the connector search surface; it does not exclude file contents, unreachable history, deleted paths, unindexed branches, tags, or external decision sources.
proposed: Treat connector code-search negatives as lead-only until an indexed search or direct exhaustive tree traversal is retained.
Require an explicit coverage manifest before changing M-004, M-005, or M-006 from unresolved to unlocated.
superseded: Interpreting a zero-result connector search as proof of repository-wide absence.
unresolved: Immutable provenance and originating source for M-004.
Immutable provenance and originating source for M-005.
Immutable provenance and originating source for M-006.
Exhaustive branch, tag, reachable-tree, and commit-history coverage.

next_action: Run a retained exhaustive traversal of refs, tags, reachable commits, and trees with content grep for M-004, M-005, and M-006; bind the result to an immutable coverage manifest before classifying any identifier as unlocated.
